job.job_description:
Gurugram, Haryana, India
Job Type
Full Time
About the Role
Were looking for a Generative AI Engineer to design and optimize AI system interactions. Youll craft effective prompts for various projects while ensuring optimal performance and user experience. You ll work on building a multimodal framework.
Requirements
Responsibilities:
Design, write, and optimize text-based prompts for AI models (e.g., GPT-4, Claude, etc.) to ensure optimal model responses.
Work on refining prompt structures to achieve more accurate and context-aware outputs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand AI use cases and develop prompts tailored to specific needs.
Test and analyze AI model outputs, identifying areas for improvement.
Continuously experiment with different prompt variations to enhance model performance.
Participate in training sessions and workshops to deepen knowledge of AI model behavior and prompt engineering techniques.
Document prompt strategies, findings, and improvements for future reference and sharing with the team.
Requirements:
Familiarity with at least one major LLM platform.
Understanding of AI model fine-tuning and optimization techniques.
Strong interest in AI and machine learning technologies.
Strong understanding of natural language processing (NLP) and how AI models work.
Portfolio demonstrating successful prompt engineering projects
Proficiency in performance analysis and debugging
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.
1 year of development experience in Python (Freshers are welcome if you can demonstrate your skills)
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Join us in shaping the future of AI interactions and contribute to cutting-edge technology development.


About the Company
Chapter Apps Inc focuses on driving change in how people learn and work in the rapidly evolving Enterprise landscape. With a strong emphasis on data security and generative AI solutions, Chapter Apps ensures businesses can expand their needs securely and efficiently. The company has a proven track record of empowering Indias largest companies through innovative training platforms and tools.
